messages:
viv: Heads-up — small pricing experiment planned for next week. Goal: add an inline estimator, change tier microcopy, and test a CTA variant that says 'Estimate my monthly bill'. Also trial a gated webinar invite for high-estimate visitors. Need owners for copy, infra, routing, and legal. akshay: I can do analytics schema + funnel. Proposed events: rw_calc_open, rw_calc_submit, rw_calc_estimate_usd, rw_calc_webinar_optin. Payload should include estimated_monthly_usd, currency, locale, tier_choice, utm_campaign, anonymous_id. claire: I'll own the FAQ + tier microcopy. Suggest tiers: Free / Growth / Enterprise. For the experiment replace 'Growth' with 'Pro' in variant B to see language lift. Also propose small FAQ lines about rounding and currency support. peter-sales: Routing asks: if estimated_monthly_usd >= 7500 OR user checks 'Enterprise interest' -> route to AE. Also for webinar gating, if estimate >= 15000 mark as 'high-value' and auto-invite to an 'Enterprise cost-savings' webinar. Can you add fields: estimated_segment (self-serve / mid-market / enterprise) and webinar_eligible boolean? sylvia-legal: Quick legal check: avoid wording that promises uptime or guaranteed pricing. Use "Enterprise customers can opt for SLA-backed support". Also flag that any per-customer pricing shown is an estimate and not a contract. availability: dev-bot: PR opened to staging by akshay: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/2100 (:rocket:) viv: Implementation notes: embed as JS widget preferred to capture locale and currency client-side. Claire, can you provide copy variants by Monday? Akshay, need analytics mapping and BigQuery table names. Peter, sales needs webhook field spec. akshay: JS snippet prototype: ```html
``` Will include a callback that POSTs to /webhook/pricing-leads with the payload. claire: Will drop copy diffs into the doc: https://docs.google.com/price-experiment (draft) — variants: "Growth" vs "Pro", CTA baseline 'Get started' vs test 'Estimate my monthly bill'. Also add FAQ Q: "Do estimates account for discounts or reserved capacity?" with answer pointing to contact sales for custom quotes. peter-sales: Confirmed webhook fields and threshold. Also request a daily CSV export of leads for the test window and a Slack alert for any estimate >= 25000. sylvia-legal: Approve FAQ language about estimates being non-binding and the SLA phrasing. No other compliance blockers. viv: Timeline: widget in staging by Tue afternoon, QA Wed, experiment live Thu. Run for 21 days. Metrics: primary = pricing page CTA -> signup conversion lift. Secondary = Contact Sales reduction and webinar RSVP rate among high estimates. akshay: I'll instrument GA4 + BigQuery export. Naming convention: rw_calc_* and BigQuery table: marketing_pricing_estimates_v1. Also adding an alert if rw_calc_contact_click increases by >20% vs baseline. claire: Will localize copy for en-US and en-GB (currency wording). Question: do we want euro support in first iteration? peter-sales: Good to have EUR, but if that's heavy dev work prefer to launch USD-only and add currency selector in week 2. availability: dev-bot: Staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-experiment-localization (build-2026-09-18-317) viv: Thanks team. Please post staging links, QA notes, and webhook spec here. We'll review first-week telemetry and decide on webinar invite cadence. :tada:
